title: C++ Software Engineer (BE-CSS-DSP-2026-90-GRAP)
description:
Location: Geneva, Switzerland (Hybrid)
Contract: 24 months (extendable to 36)
Start: 1 September 2026
Closing date: 21 June 2026
Stipend: 6372–7004 CHF/month (tax free)

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design, develop and deploy C++ software for the ISOLDE timing system upgrade at CERN
- Work with the White Rabbit timing technology and real-time software framework for equipment control
- Develop software controlling White Rabbit hardware modules for equipment synchronisation
- Contribute to adaptation of existing real-time software to the new timing system

REQUIRED PROFILE
- Proven C++ development experience in Linux/Unix environments, including real-time systems
- Experience with low-level development, libraries and kernel modules
- Software quality assurance techniques and tooling

KEY SKILLS
- Hands-on C++ (real-time, embedded, low-level)
- Linux, kernel modules, low-level libraries
- Object-oriented programming, DevOps, testing and optimisation
- Monitoring and troubleshooting of operational software
- English required, French a plus

ELIGIBILITY
- National of a CERN Member/Associate Member State
- Master's degree + 2–6 years post-graduation experience, or PhD + up to 3 years
- No previous CERN fellow or graduate contract

Field: Software Engineering and IT (Controls Software & Services group, Timing team)
